interest: Reveals prewar Japanese naval oil procurement in Los Angeles and German technical assistance for wartime submarine refits.
overview: This file comprises U.S. State Department diplomatic correspondence, FBI investigative reports, and allied intelligence records from 1940 to 1944 concerning Japanese naval expansion, shipbuilding capabilities, and procurement activities. It documents U.S. investigations into covert Japanese naval inspection and oil purchasing operations based out of Los Angeles, detailed assessments of Japanese shipyards, dockyard capacities, and construction delays, as well as intelligence regarding capital ship construction. Additionally, wartime despatches from Chungking provide Chinese intelligence on a major 1944 refitting and modernization program for Japanese surface warships and submarines conducted with German technical assistance.
